name: Chicken Achari
description: Tangy Pakistani chicken achari cooked with tomatoes, yogurt and aromatic pickling spices for a bold, slightly sour curry.
ingredients: Salt and lemon juice to taste
method: Heat oil and fry the onion until soft and lightly golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and chicken, then fry until the chicken changes colour.
Add tomatoes, red chili, turmeric and salt and cook until the tomatoes soften.
Whisk the yogurt and stir it in over medium-low heat.
Crush the fennel, nigella, mustard and fenugreek lightly and add them with the green chilies.
Cover and cook until the chicken is tender and the masala is thick.
Finish with a little lemon juice for extra tang and serve hot.
